"''You want a rematch?''"
"''Why not?|Han Solo and Lando Calrissian catch the attention of Wazellman and other sabacc players|audio=Solo-Calrissian-BuyIn.flac|}} '''Wazellman''' was a [[Wickwar]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Wick 111]] who participated in a game of [[sabacc]] on the planet [[Numidian Prime]] with the [[Gambling|gamblers]] [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] in [[10 BBY]]. Sitting next to Solo, Wazellman saw him eventually win Calrissian's [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. In [[34 ABY]], the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] used Wazellman's [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile to test several potential new employees of [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]]. ==Biography== ===Disgruntled gambler=== [[File:NumidianPrimeGamblers.png|thumb|left|250px|Wazellman (bottom left) played sabacc on Numidian Prime.]] Wazellman was a [[Wickwar]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'' [[Wick 111]] around [[35 BBY]]. In [[10 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[sabacc]] game on [[Numidian Prime]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[10 BBY]]. Wazellman took part in a [[sabacc]] game at a guarded [[Cantina|bar]] in a hard-to-find [[jungle outpost]] on the planet [[Numidian Prime]]. Other participants included the [[Gambling|gamblers]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Landonis Calrissian]],''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' [[Pride Aully]],{{DatapadCite|Need Jetpack. Have Credits.|PrideAullyMission-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyConv-GEDatapad.png|PrideAullyConv2-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyConv3-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyComplete-GEDatapad.jpg}} and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], who arrived partway through the game and confronted Calrissian about recently [[Showdown on Savareen|abandoning]] him on the planet [[Savareen]]. Solo then used a container of [[coaxium]] he believed to be worth around 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to buy into the game, catching the attention of Wazellman and the rest of the table, as that amount was worth more than the average bargaining chip on Numidian Prime. The Wickwar moved to a different seat at the table to allow Solo and his [[Pilot|co-pilot]], the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], to sit down beside Wazellman. ===A game like no other=== The group then played on, with Solo losing some rounds and winning others but slowly building a small pile of winnings in front of him. Some of the others left the table in a rage as the seemingly personal battle between Solo and Calrissian played out. Eventually, most of the players other than Solo and Calrissian dropped out or folded, but most, including Wazellman, stayed to watch, as the match was like nothing they had seen before. Calrissian eventually put his [[YT-1300 light freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', up as a bet, but Solo then won the hand and the ''Falcon''. Wazellman and the others who had seen the marathon game of sabacc each went on to give different accounts of what had happened, each focusing on different aspects of the story but all agreeing about the conclusion.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel]]'' [[File:Wazellman-NumidianPrime.png|thumb|right|300px|Wazellman (left) witnessed Han Solo win the ''Millennium Falcon''.]] During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]] in [[34 ABY]], when Wazellman was 69 [[Standard year|years]] old, the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] used a [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile of the Wickwar to test a group of potential new employees for his company, [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]]. Ohnaka was planning a [[Heist on a First Order train|heist]] and wanted to test the employees' ability to memorize details from a cover identity, so he sent the profile of Wazellman and several other individuals to the prospective employees' [[datapad]]s and then quizzed them on details from the data. ==Personality and traits== Wazellman stood 3 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches tall and weighed 125 [[pound]]s. The Wickwar had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, no [[hair]], and pink facial [[Limb|tentacles]]. While playing sabacc against Lando Calrissian on Numidian Prime, Wazellman and the other participants were disgruntled and became impatient when Han Solo interrupted their game. Calrissian considered Wazellman and the other players ill-mannered and menacing. ==Equipment== Wazellman wore a gray [[helmet]] and [[Armor|chestplate]] over black [[clothing]] on Numidian Prime. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We're using a lot of stuff that was built for other movies, like alien suits and things. So, um, in the spirit of television, we're using resources from the features.|Producer Jon Favreau, commenting on reusing resources like Wazellman's costume in ''The Mandalorian''|audio=JonFavreau-Resources-DG.flac|{{DisneyGallery|Connections}}}} [[File:Wazellman-Mandalorian.png|thumb|right|250px|Wazellman's costume was reused in ''The Mandalorian''.]] Wazellman first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The character was portrayed by actor [[Warwick Davis]], who also portrayed the characters [[Weazel]], [[W1-EG5]], [[WG-22]],''[[Star Wars: Book of Lists]]'' and [[DD-BD]] in the film.{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/warwick-davis-interview-solo-star-wars-story|text=Warwick Davis Interview: Solo: A Star Wars Story|author=Leadbeater, Alex|date=2018-09-25|work=[[Wikipedia:Screen Rant|''Screen Rant'']]|archivedate=20181006054346}} Concept art of the character titled "Bandolero Version 7A" was created for the film by creature concept designer [[Ivan Manzella]], with the character being designed specifically with Warwick in mind.''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' The character was first identified in [[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]], an app that launched alongside the themed land [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], which first opened to guests at [[Disneyland]] Park on [[May
